correctness.rationale: Proof verifies B full column rank, im B=even-sum hyperplane, ker B^T=span(ones), so line-graph adjacency nullity is 0 or 1 by tree-size parity. Parity of odd-component forest count forces odd zero multiplicity s; nullity one forces one Jordan block of that size. Fitting counts follow exactly, and path/star extrema via continuant and idempotent matrices. Finite verification on 1661 trees plus explicit power-of-two extremes was independently replayed; finite tests are corroboration only.
